basis: league total stated in Congressional hearing (total revenues of NFL member clubs)
source_quote: The total revenues, Mr. Bell, of the members of the National Football League in 1952 were $8,327,117, and in 1956 were $12,370,074. Now, the total for this period amounted to $52,420,106.
notes: House Judiciary Antitrust Subcommittee, Organized Professional Team Sports, Part 3, 85th Cong. 1st sess. (1957), p. 2525 (counsel Harkins questioning Commissioner Bert Bell). The club statements (pp. 2562-2565) cover 11 clubs: no report for the 1952 Dallas Texans (franchise turned back to the league mid-season). Sum of the 11 clubs' gross operating income in Fort's transcription = $8,327,021. Gross operating income = home gate (net), road gate share, exhibition games, radio and television, net concessions, other income.
